podcast.body: This song was being performed by Eagles of Death Metal at the Bataclan venue in Paris on November 13, 2015. The band was approximately 45 minutes into their set and had reached the guitar solo when gunmen stormed the venue and opened fire. "Eagles of Death Metal got as far as the guitar solo before the gunman opened fire."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was the third song Eagles of Death Metal were performing at the Bataclan Theater in Paris on November 13, 2015, when armed terrorists stormed the venue, initiating a mass shooting. "Eagles of Death Metal was into the third song of the night. It was called Kiss the Devil."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 9: (20-11)
